jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
 Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor. Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
 Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.title: Military Security Officer
jobs.description: Job Title: Security & Law Enforcement (Master-at-Arms)Category / Component:Enlisted ActiveThis role is open to both entry-level applicants and candidates with prior experience. Those with a background in Law Enforcement, Corrections/Parole, or as a Security Practitioner may qualify for direct-entry consideration at an advanced paygrade (E-4 to E-6) depending on experience.OverviewMaster-at-Arms (MA) Sailors provide the Navys core security, anti-terrorism, and law enforcement capability, protecting people, installations, ships, and strategic assets at home and abroad. They conduct force protection, physical security, and policing on bases, aboard ships, at sea, and in expeditionary environments, and may specialize in areas such as military working dogs, harbor security, corrections, investigations, or protective services.Key ResponsibilitiesConduct anti-terrorism and force protection patrols on installations and piers; stand sentry and access control posts and control entry to secure areas; perform vehicle, personnel, and baggage inspections to detect weapons, contraband, or unauthorized items; enforce traffic and parking regulations, respond to calls for service, and investigate incidents and traffic accidents; collect and preserve evidence and prepare reports and case files; provide law enforcement presence and crowd control during special events and emergencies; operate and maintain small arms, crew-served weapons, non-lethal weapons, and security vehicles or boats; support harbor and waterside security, high-value unit escorts, and expeditionary security missions; supervise and train junior security force personnel in watch standing, weapons, and security procedures.What to ExpectWork in a fast-paced, armed, and safety-critical environment where attention to detail, judgment, and professionalism are essential; frequent duty in rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to provide 24/7 security and law enforcement coverage; exposure to stressful situations involving emergencies, accidents, or criminal activity, requiring calm decision-making and strong communication; ongoing qualification and requalification in weapons, use of force, tactical skills, and physical fitness; increasing responsibility over time as you qualify for specialized billets such as patrol supervisor, watch commander, kennel master, or investigator.Work EnvironmentAssignments at Navy installations in the U.S. and overseas, aboard aircraft carriers and other ships, and with expeditionary security units and strategic weapons facilities; work primarily on bases, piers, flight lines, harbor security boats, and in patrol vehicles, kennels, armories, and security operations centers; opportunities for overseas, forward-deployed, and dependent-restricted tours that count as sea duty for rotation; close integration with other security forces, Marine units, NCIS, and joint or host-nation partners depending on billet.Pathways, Training & AdvancementRecruit Training followed by Master-at-Arms Class A School at Lackland AFB, where you learn basic law enforcement, weapons handling, anti-terrorism, patrol procedures, and security operations; progressive on-the-job qualification through Personnel Qualification Standards, watch stations, and unit training; opportunities for advanced schools that award Navy Enlisted Classifications such as Military Working Dog Handler and Kennel Master, Harbor Security Coxswain and Patrol Leader, Corrections Specialist, Small Arms Instructor, Crew-Served Weapons Instructor, Protective Service Specialist, and Criminal Investigator; career-long development through leadership courses, warfare qualifications (such as ESWS, EAWS, EXW, FMF, or NWS when assigned to qualifying commands), and senior enlisted leader programs.Enlist directly into the Master-at-Arms rating and attend MA A School after Recruit Training, then report to an operational security force billet at an installation, ship, or expeditionary unit; Reserve opportunities may exist in Navy Security Force and Maritime Expeditionary Security units for qualified prior-service or SELRES applicants, often requiring completion of MA A School or equivalent training and, for some billets, specific NECs or follow-on schools; prior-service Sailors from other ratings may be able to convert into MA based on community needs and screening.QualificationsAll Navy jobs require meeting general enlistment or commissioning standards, which typically includes:Eligibility to serve in the United States Navy, which may involve United States citizenship or other legal residency and work status, depending on the program and current law and policyA high school diploma or equivalent for enlisted positions, and a bachelors or qualifying professional degree for officer positionsMeeting age limits that vary by program and are set in law and Navy policy. Some communities have more restrictive age rangesMeeting medical, vision, and dental standards, including body composition and…

jobs.description:
The City of Duncanville is a beautiful suburb community that boarders the southwest part of Dallas Texas. Duncanville PD is a Civil Service Department and will be hosting a civil service test on August 1st 2026 at the Duncanville Recreation Center building located at 201 James Collins Blvd., Duncanville. Doors open at 7:00 AM and close at 8:00 AM. THE ONLINE APPLICATION MUST be submitted prior to test date. The link is provided below:

https://www.duncanvilletx.gov/residents/public_safety/police_department/recruitment


Job description:

Overview

The Police Officer plays a crucial role in maintaining public safety and enforcing the law within the community. This position requires a dedicated individual who is committed to serving and protecting citizens while upholding the values of integrity, professionalism, and respect. As a Police Officer, you will engage with the community, respond to emergencies, conduct investigations, and ensure compliance with local laws.

Duties

- Patrol assigned areas to deter and detect criminal activity.

- Respond promptly to calls for service and emergencies.

- Conduct thorough investigations of incidents, including gathering evidence and interviewing witnesses.

- Prepare detailed reports documenting incidents, arrests, and other relevant information.

- Enforce traffic laws and regulations; issue citations as necessary.

- Manage conflicts effectively to de-escalate potentially volatile situations.

- Provide first aid and CPR when necessary; assist in emergency medical situations.

- Handle animals in distress or involved in incidents, ensuring their safety and welfare.

- Utilize surveillance techniques to monitor suspicious activities within the community.

- Collaborate with other law enforcement agencies as needed.


Salary and Benefits:

New officers with no experience will receive $2,500.00 bonus upon completion of field training.

Officers who hold a current Texas Commission on Law Enforcement (TCOLE) Peace Officer Certification will receive the following after completion of field training based on years of service as a licensed peace officer:

Less than 2 years: $5,000

Through the programs and services provided, individuals develop essential life skills to become independent, productive members of our community. UGM-TC is God’s healthy place to end homelessness one person at a time. Come serve with us!  




UGM is seeking a flexible Security Patrol Officer able to work a variable schedule regarding hours and days worked based on the organization's changing needs.






Position Summary:


The selected individual will patrol and secure assigned premises as well as identify and mitigate risks to staff and patrons. We are looking for active, dependable individuals that are highly motivated. Former military or law enforcement experience preferred! This position requires individuals to stand/walk for extended periods of time. There will be routine checks and code compliance requirements for the 10-acre campus of Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County.  We also service The Vineyards of Lancaster, registering visitors, taking calls, and ensuring visitors have registered vehicles while conducting routine patrols. 


What You Do: 



  • Patrol buildings and grounds. 

  • Maintain campus security and follow lock protocols. 

  • Provides individual and group escorts to and from parking areas. 

  • Identifies and removes unauthorized individuals from property. 

  • Enforces campus parking policies/cites violations. 

  • Executes Courtesy Patrol policies, procedures, and standards with excellence. 

  • Provides campus directions to facility visitors. 

  • Interacts with police, fire personnel, EMS, patients, visitors, and staff. 

  • Completes incident / offense reports and composes narratives by performing investigations, recording observations, taking statements, gathering information, citing occurrences, and utilizing surveillance activities.  

  • Make eye contact and greet all people with respect. 

  • Responds to calls for service and emergency situations with urgency and professionalism. 

  • Assesses the situation and utilizes appropriate de-escalation measures. 

  • Utilizes critical thinking skills. 

  • Responds to and activates the appropriate emergency response codes.  

  • Supports activities and events by utilizing appropriate crowd control techniques representative of UGM.  

  • Work overnights, weekends, evening hours, and holidays as needed by the organization.  

  • The central job functions of this position are not limited to the duties listed above. 


 


Qualifications / What You Bring:  



  • 3-5 years of security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred. 

  • Familiarity with security equipment.

  • Ability to handle physical workload (walking/standing)

  • Bilingual:  Spanish Speaking a plus

  • Level 2 License preferred

  • Strong attention to detail 

  • An ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds at varying levels of understanding.  

  • Problem Sensitivity — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem. 

  • Deductive Reasoning — The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. 

  • Flexibility of Closure — The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material. 

  • Inductive Reasoning — The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events). 

  • A clean driving record.






“As part of the screening process, you may be asked to provide a pastoral reference. Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a Christian organization that seeks to hire people who align with our beliefs in Jesus Christ. We welcome all Christian denominations into the mission.”

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Teammate - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

2nd Shift Opportunity

Monday - Thursday

4:00pm-2:30am

$20.05/hr + $1.00/hr shift differential

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Integrity, shrink control and profit protection.

  • Conduct and assist in internal investigations (theft, dishonesty, policy violations, human resources) in the DC.
  • Conduct and assist with external investigations related to cargo theft to and from the DC’s.
  • Complete daily, weekly, monthly & quarterly audits
  • Conduct lane inspections/ carton scans to improve operational accuracy and document in LPMS / DSGiQ (case management systems)
  • Compile and reconcile data for Seal Verification reporting.
    • Researches, resolves and documents discrepancies.
  • Review inventory adjustment details in order to research high dollar losses.
  • Complete store research to identify & resolve misdirected freight issues.
    • This includes variance investigations for DC & field related issues.
  • Partner with Federal Authorities in relation to Firearms control and reporting.
Report all findings to database, email contacts and immediate alerts if within criteria.

Safety and Emergency Preparedness

  • Work closely with Operations & Leadership team to investigate incidents which includes document review, visual inspections. Clearly communicate findings with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Serve as support for potentially volatile terminations and /or situations within location.
  • Supports accident investigations with video review and detailed reporting.

Conduct weekly / monthly / quarterly Safety Assessments to ensure overall safety compliance and reports findings.

Physical Security and Investigations

  • Responsible for security screening all people entering/exiting the facility per DSG requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot and respond to all alarm systems (burglar, Fire & Amarok [perimeter electrified fence])
  • Opening/Closing of DC facility per DSG guidelines without supervision
  • Complete building walkthrough multiple times throughout daily shift
    • Focusing on misdirected freight, safety, physical security, firearm security, & deterrence
  • Knowledge of Genetec system, create access control badges & ensure all building credentials are accurate.
  • Complete daily observations of facility and document /address opportunities.
Conduct and / or support investigations in regard to concerns or violations of the physical security of assigned location and report findings.

Yard Management

  • Assist guard shack as needed with inbound/outbound trailer procedures. Provide physical control of guard shack and perform duties for emergency coverage if / when needed.
  • Resolve daily logs to allow proper YMS (Yard Management System) workflows to be followed.
  • Assist with passive yard control requests.
  • Reconcile Yard Audit results to ensure yard accuracy.
  • Provide direction to 3rd party staff.

Conduct and / or support investigations in to concerns or violations of trailer yard of location and report findings.

Other

  • Conduct Social Engineering Drills with the stores on a regular basis.
  • Assigned schedule can be temporary / permanently changed as needed for the needs of the business.
  • Help maintain inventory of LP Supplies & distribute store orders.
  • Serve as resource/provide guidance to warehouse teammates for a variety of topics.
  • Must be available to be on call during off hours.
  • Must be flexible to cover additional hours to provide support during special projects and facility overtime.
  • Assist in New Hire orientation for Loss Prevention introduction for new Teammates.
  • Support other departments in investigations, presence or as needed. i.e., Human Resources, Operations, Logistics.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • 1-3 years experience
  • Loss Prevention, Asset Protection, Profit Protection, Operations, Safety, Logistics
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, reach, push, pull and lift 10-50 pounds intermittently.
  • Basic English reading comprehension & numerical reasoning skills.

Virtual Requirements

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.
  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.
  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!
